name: Rakshak Nayak / ରକ୍ଷକ ନାୟକ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rakshak Nayak writes poetry and prose in Odia. His collections include Urdhwa Udaana, Brahmasila and Asaranti Antakshari. Black Eagle Books identifies Asaranti Antakshari as the collection that received the Odisha Sahitya Akademi Award for 2013. His poetry has also appeared in Hindi translation: Hindwi presents “Pratham aur Antim” in Shankar Lal Purohit’s translation.

His Kabita Live poems turn cultural memory into searching questions. “୰ ପ୍ରାଚୀ” mourns the Prachi river while asking whether its loss was inevitable or caused by those around it. In “ପାଞ୍ଚପଡ଼ା”, a request for five settlements becomes a tense exchange about generosity, power and what remains for the giver. Both poems place a familiar inheritance under the pressure of a questioning voice.
